name: telegram
description: Telegram chat bridge. Mirrors chat.input / chat.response between the brAIn bus and a Telegram bot (paste a BotFather token to connect).

default_subscriptions.description: Mirrored to Telegram for every known chat (except when the message itself originated from Telegram — loop guard via metadata.platform).
Brain (or other node) replies (exact-topic flavor used by the default seed).
Brain (or other node) replies with a sub-topic suffix (e.g. chat.response.user1).
UI control plane — `{action: connect|disconnect|status}`. The UI publishes here from `system.telegram-ui` after saving a new bot_token so the handler picks the change up immediately.
